text: For partial correctness, the Hoare triple {P} C {Q} holds if and only if P implies wp(C, Q).
explanation: True: this is the defining link between Hoare logic and the weakest-precondition calculus. Since wp(C, Q) is the least restrictive precondition guaranteeing Q, any valid precondition P must imply it, turning verification into checking P ⇒ wp(C, Q).
